_comment: Frontier-scan source list. GitHub repos are pulled deterministically by fetch_sources.py (releases + tags). Sources without a stable repo (kind=web) are left to the agent's WebSearch step in scan-prompt.md. Add/remove freely — owner-tunable.

sources.name: Claude Agent SDK (Python)
sources.why_track: Anthropic's own agent framework — new primitives here are directly adoptable by Sutando.

sources.name: Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript)
sources.why_track: TS side of the Agent SDK — Sutando's core is TS, so these land closest to home.

sources.name: Letta (MemGPT)
sources.why_track: Long-term agent memory architecture — relevant to Sutando's memory + fleet-context work.

sources.name: OpenAI Swarm
sources.why_track: Lightweight multi-agent handoff patterns — maps onto the Maverick/Goose/Charlie fleet.

sources.name: Nous Research / Hermes
sources.why_track: Hermes 'Jeepa' auto-skill loop inspired skill-synth; watch for new agent/skill tooling.

sources.name: OpenClaw
sources.why_track: Owner-flagged agentic runtime (calendar-versioned). Ships features that map straight onto Sutando: durable task orchestration (TaskFlow), richer Telegram delivery, Skill Workshop, auto fast-mode. Repo confirmed 2026-06-24.

sources.name: Hermes (Nous Research) — agent releases
sources.search: Nous Research Hermes AI agent release 2026
sources.why_track: Owner-flagged competitor. The Hermes-Function-Calling repo above publishes no releases or tags, so GitHub polling sees nothing — this web lane is what actually covers Hermes agent launches.

sources.name: Grok Bots (xAI)
sources.search: xAI Grok bots agents release announcement 2026
sources.why_track: Owner-flagged competitor. Grok's agent/bot surface ships through X and xAI announcements, not a public agent repo.

sources.name: xAI SDK (Grok)
sources.why_track: The one xAI repo with real releases (5 as of 2026-09-21) — deterministic signal for Grok agent/tool-calling capability, complementing the web lane above.
